draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced unsupported-entity hallucinations in news summarization.
rationale: P1 describes the filtering method and its training, but contains no claim about reducing unsupported-entity hallucinations. No passage from Varga & Sandoval states the reduction.
